About the role

The Creator Success Program Manager partners with leadership to design and deliver scalable education, onboarding, accelerator programs, webinars, and community experiences that help creators grow their businesses on LTK. This role plays a key part in shaping creator education, developing enablement resources, and delivering impactful learning experiences across digital and in-person channels. Success in this role requires exceptional communication, presentation, and project management skills, along with a deep understanding of the creator economy and the ability to manage multiple strategic initiatives simultaneously.
How you will make an impact

Partner with leadership to develop and execute creator education programs, including onboarding, accelerator initiatives, webinars, and scalable learning experiences.
Deliver engaging workshops, webinars, and one-to-many coaching that drive creator growth, platform adoption, and business success.
Partner on creator programming for LTKCon and other creator events, including curriculum development, presentation creation, speaker preparation, and onsite execution.
Create polished presentations, educational resources, playbooks, spreadsheets, dashboards, and sales enablement materials that support both creators and internal teams.
Serve as a trusted expert on the LTK platform and creator economy, translating product updates, best practices, and industry trends into actionable education.
Partner cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, Brand Partnerships, Community, and Creator Success teams to continuously improve creator programs and experiences.
Analyze creator feedback and program performance to identify opportunities, measure impact, and recommend improvements.
Manage multiple high-impact projects simultaneously while maintaining strong organization, operational excellence, and attention to detail.
Travel as needed (typically several times per month during busy seasons - fall, spring) to support onboarding, creator events, LTKCon, and other strategic initiatives.

What you will bring to LTK

3+ years of experience in creator success, education, program management, community building, influencer marketing, sales enablement, or a related field.
Experience building and scaling educational programs, onboarding experiences, or creator communities.
Strong presentation, facilitation, curriculum development, and public speaking experience for audiences of varying sizes.
Experience planning and supporting creator-facing events, conferences, or large-scale educational programming.
Proficiency with Google Slides or PowerPoint and Google Sheets or Excel to create compelling presentations, training materials, and reporting.
Deep understanding of social media platforms, creator monetization, and the evolving creator economy.
Strong analytical, communication, project management, and storytelling skills.
CRM experience (HubSpot or equivalent) preferred.
Willingness to travel several times per month to support creator events, onboarding programs, LTKCon, and other business needs.
A mindset focused on seizing opportunities and moving with urgency
Dedication to fierce prioritization and operational excellence
Adaptability to a dynamic, fast-moving environment
A growth mindset and openness to feedback

Professional Characteristics

Exceptional presenter, educator, and facilitator with strong public speaking and storytelling skills.
Deep understanding of the creator economy, social media landscape, and creator growth strategies.
Experience developing polished presentations, educational content, and data-driven materials using Google Slides/PowerPoint and Google Sheets/Excel.
Strong project management skills with the ability to balance multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Experience creating enablement resources that drive adoption, engagement, and behavior change.
Analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into actionable recommendations.
Highly collaborative with strong cross-functional partnership and communication skills.
Passionate about helping creators grow and succeed at scale.

What we offer for full-time salaried employees
The opportunity to be part of the leading global company in creator commerce
A remote-first, productivity-first environment
Competitive compensation and benefits package to meet the needs of you and your family
401(k) with LTK company matching
Medical Insurance, Vision Insurance, Dental Insurance
Paid Maternity Leave and Paid Paternity Leave
Summer Fridays and Flexible PTO
For temporary full-time employees, benefits eligibility may vary

About LTK
Founded in 2011, LTK is the global technology platform purpose-built to empower lifestyle creators to monetize their content. The full-service platform connects brands, creators, and shoppers with a world-class shopping app and trusted tools and technology that make content instantly shoppable. Today, premium lifestyle creators in 160+ countries drive more than $5 billion+ in annual retail sales through their LTK Shop profiles. More than 40 million consumers turn to LTK Shops in the LTK shopping platform each month to find inspiration and instantly shop the styles recommended by their favorite creators. More than 8,000 retailers and 1M brands partner with LTK to gain access to its global creator network for content that converts against performance-driven, cross-channel KPIs. LTK is headquartered in Dallas, TX, and currently operates on five continents.
Our mission
To empower the world’s premium lifestyle Creators to achieve maximum economic success.
Our values
Here to win
Commit to the journey
Work well

Commitment to diversity
LTK believes diversity, equity, and inclusion are fundamental obligations that strengthen our team. We employ a diverse, multi-disciplinary team to build a meaningful company and culture.

Hill International is seeking a Program Manager – Utilities for Texas. This is a full-time position.

We are looking for a leader who is passionate about managing utility programs and projects on large campuses. This is an opportunity to be part of growing a team of project managers and building a practice in Western United States. Extensive experience with a variety of projects and the ability to manage multiple clients and teams is required.

Develop client relationships and participate in business development processes and activities
Execute the client’s program strategy involving the design and execution of strategic multi-site utility projects
Provide financial management oversight and work with the client to build, forecast, and monitor multi-million dollar capital improvement and operating budgets
Provide guidance on vendor & contract oversight of multiple designers, contractors and third party vendors / contractors
Assist the client in negotiating service level agreements with external contractors, engineers, and suppliers
Direct long-term utility programs across multiple sites to ensure safe, efficient, and compliant operations
Manage and supervise staff
Familiarize client processes and develop a strategy to coordinate the requirements/needs of all interested parties. Must be able to analyze requested changes and to manage the change process
Assist project management team with coordinating communications between contractor, client, site personnel, and consulting engineers
Make recommendations on project plan: design, scope, contract issues, budget and actual cost analysis, proposed changes, schedule changes and project extensions
Maintain project budget, manage contractor schedules and report on decisions regarding design, specifications, costs, schedule and program or risk for practice
Ability to review project documents (drawings, specifications, RFI’s, schedules, etc.) and evaluate the completeness for the respective phase of design and/or construction
Responsible for managing the quality of the project(s) and manage facility to ensure successful completion as it relates to “on time” and within budget

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Architecture, Engineering or similar required
Familiarity of public utility commission rules, regional organizations and compliance standards.
Understanding utility systems architecture and construction markets.
10-15 years of relevant experience, including leading multi-staffed teams
Excellent communication skills including the ability to interact with C-Suite level clients
Knowledge of local and national building codes, ADA requirements and familiarity with Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) safety requirements on construction projects
Advanced knowledge of business operations and project management
Exceptional leadership and mentorship abilities to introduce and implement technical solutions
Must be willing to work full time onsite

Hill International, with more than 4,300+ professionals in over 100 offices worldwide, provides program management, project management, construction management, project management oversight, advisory, facilities management, and other consulting services to clients in a variety of market sectors. Engineering News-Record magazine recently ranked Hill as one of the largest program management firms in the world. For more information on Hill, please visit our website at www.hillintl.com .

Hill is exclusively a program, project, and construction management provider, meaning we have one focus as a company: protecting client interests. Free of any potential conflicts, our entire business is geared towards helping clients achieve their desired outcomes. We are dedicated to exceeding expectations throughout the entire construction project lifecycle and adapt to the needs of each assignment to develop tailored approaches and solutions to meet those needs.

new_jobs.title: Program Manager 2 – Brand Partnerships - Hybrid (Seattle, WA)
new_jobs.description:
Job Description

NMG BRAND PARTNERSHIPS

Program Manager 2 – Brand Partnerships

The NMG Brand Partnerships, Program Manager 2
role supports the broader work of the Brand Partnership team, spanning the Designated Selling Associate (DSA) program, unowned inventory program (supporting hybrid and concession partnerships), and other strategic NMG partnerships. This role will initially focus on leading the DSA program, with responsibilities evolving to support the broader business. This role requires a highly resourceful self-starter with an understanding of how to drive efficiencies, work with and influence cross functional partners, and deliver program excellence at scale. This individual has a unique blend of strategic, analytic and collaboration skills with demonstrated experience in taking ideas from vision to execution, blending relationship management, program management, problem-solving skills, and the ability to drive to aligned outcomes. This role requires an individual comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, dealing with ambiguity, engaging stakeholders in a productive, positive way and setting the course for the business to help drive growth for Nordstrom.

A Day in the Life…

Continue to support the DSA program while progressively expanding focus to broader partnership support across Hybrid, Concession, and other strategic partnerships.
Progress the DSA program strategy, including measuring the effectiveness of the program, setting expansion criteria, and analyzing ongoing performance management.
Responsible for cross-functional management and execution of the Designated Selling Associate (DSA) program activities, including but not limited to: tracking all open and filled DSA roles, and facilitating timely communication and decision making across HR, Stores, Brands, and Merchant Teams.
Partner with Brand Partnership Leads to support partnership readiness and brand support across the Unowned Inventory portfolio.
Support contract management and governance for DSA program and unowned model partnerships, including drafting, tracking, and maintaining agreements to ensure compliance with program standards.
Conduct business analytics to evaluate partnership and program performance, surfacing insights and recommendations that inform strategic decisions.

Job Description

The Role

The Safety Assurance for Effective Autonomous Driving Software (SAFE-ADS) department is part of the Global Product Safety, System, and Certification (GPSSC) organization at GM. The SAFE-ADS department serves as the central body for automated driving system (ADS) safety and brings together expertise from across the company to establish a comprehensive safety case. GM’s vision is zero crashes, zero emissions, and zero congestion – AV safety is at the heart of driving forward this vision.

GM is seeking an Autonomous Vehicle Regulatory Program Manager to lead cross-functional regulatory compliance and engagement programs that support the safe development, testing, deployment, and continuous improvement of automated driving systems (ADS). This role is focused on broader ADS compliance and regulatory readiness, including regulatory strategy, requirement management, agency engagement support, reporting coordination, milestone planning, risk management, and cross-functional execution.

The successful candidate will work closely with Safety, Engineering, Legal, Government Affairs, Operations, and Product teams to translate regulatory requirements into actionable workplans, track execution across multiple stakeholders, and help ensure GM is prepared for submissions, inquiries, audits, assessments, and evolving external expectations. This role requires a strong program manager who can bring structure to complex work, manage dependencies and risks, and drive clarity across technical and non-technical teams.

What You'll Do

Define and drive the execution model for AV regulatory compliance programs across GPSSC, Legal, Government Affairs, Engineering, Operations, and other key stakeholders.
Build and maintain integrated program plans, milestones, timelines, and dependency tracking for regulatory workstreams supporting AV development, testing, launch readiness, and post-launch obligations.
Coordinate the identification, documentation, interpretation, and operationalization of regulatory requirements across federal, state, and local jurisdictions relevant to autonomous vehicle development and deployment.
Partner with cross-functional teams to translate regulatory requirements into engineering, operational, validation, reporting, and process workplans, and track execution to completion.
Support regulatory submissions, recurring reports, audits, assessments, and formal inquiries by coordinating inputs, timelines, reviews, approvals, and issue resolution across stakeholders.
Coordinate responses to regulator questions, data requests, incident-related inquiries, and investigations in partnership with Safety, Engineering, Operations, Legal, and Government Affairs teams.
Establish and run clear program governance, including status reviews, risk management, action tracking, decision logs, and escalation pathways for regulatory initiatives.
Proactively identify schedule, scope, compliance, and cross-functional dependency risks; develop mitigation plans; and escalate issues when appropriate.
Drive continuous improvement in regulatory planning, execution, tools, processes, and cross-team collaboration to improve efficiency, readiness, and transparency.
Partner with technical leaders and subject matter experts to ensure regulatory strategies and deliverables are grounded in sound technical understanding and defensible safety practices.
Establish and own regulatory related safety case claims, sufficiency criteria and recommended evidence.
Support the broader AV safety case and safety assurance workstreams by helping align regulatory expectations, milestones, and externally facing materials with internal safety strategy and execution.
Help improve traceability between regulatory requirements, program deliverables, evidence, and status so leadership can make timely, well-informed decisions.

Your Skills & Abilities (Required Qualifications)

new_jobs.title: Engineering IT Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About The Team

ArsenalOS is the digital backbone of Anduril’s hardware enterprise. It connects the full lifecycle, from concept to build to field feedback, into one operating environment built for speed, traceability, autonomy, and continuous improvement. That environment includes not just the software used to design, plan, and execute work, but also the factory-facing infrastructure that connects operators, machines, test systems, and OT networks into the same adaptive Build Chain. It is not a support function, but rather a strategic investment by Anduril that the operating system of the hardware lifecycle is how we win. It will be one of the mechanisms by which Anduril out-builds, out-adapts, and out-scales the traditional defense industrial base. We are looking for a Engineering Solutions Application Engineer to work with our team of developers and partner with cross functional teams across the company to develop customizations, optimize workflows and ensure engineering tools do not limit the speed of engineering design.

About The Job

We are seeking a highly skilled Technical Program Manager to join our team. You will be responsible for helping product and program teams maximize the value they get out of the engineering tools and systems they use on a daily basis (CAD, CAE, Requirements tools etc.). You will work across a broad set of stakeholders to design, develop, and implement improvements and optimizations to our engineering systems while helping steer future investments. Beyond optimizing existing tools, this individual will also have a hand in helping operate a portfolio of internal products, vendor pilots, platform decisions, integrations, upgrades, and KTLO initiatives.

What You’ll Do

Translate product strategy and portfolio priorities into executable programs, milestones, owners, and outcomes.
Maintain visibility across concurrent workstreams, dependencies, risks, decisions, and resourcing gaps.
Drive execution across engineering users, software teams, infrastructure, security, procurement, system owners, and vendors.
Identify missing handoffs and unwritten work, converting them into accountable plans.
Facilitate requirements and scope definition with product, customer, and technical owners.
Lead pilots, implementations, migrations, rollouts, adoption, and operational handoffs.
Provide concise, decision-ready updates and escalate consequential tradeoffs early.

Required Qualifications

5+ years of relevant engineering, technical program management, or engineering-systems implementation experience.
Familiarity with platforms such as NX, Simcenter, Teamcenter, Cameo/TWC, Jama, or comparable systems.
Experience with MCAD, ECAD, CAE, MBSE, requirements-management, simulation, or engineering-data platforms.
Demonstrated success leading multiple concurrent, technically complex programs across organizational boundaries.
Working knowledge of engineering workflows and systems, with meaningful depth in at least one domain.
Experience coordinating internal development teams, engineering customers, infrastructure partners, and external vendors.
Technical fluency with system integrations, APIs, data flows, authentication, and enterprise deployments.
Experience managing plans, dependencies, risks, decisions, delivery readiness, and stakeholder communication.
Excellent facilitation, written communication, judgment, and follow-through.
Must be a US person.

Preferred Qualifications

Prior experience as a practicing mechanical, electrical, systems, or analysis engineer.
Experience delivering pilots, migrations, major upgrades, or internal engineering products through adoption.
Experience in aerospace, defense, automotive, or complex hardware manufacturing.
Familiarity with digital-thread, Model-Based Enterprise, data-migration, and ETL concepts.
Experience with enterprise licensing, procurement, security reviews, and vendor management.

US Salary Range

$129,000—$171,000 USD

Benefits

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To Ensure Your Safety And Help You Navigate Your Job Search With Confidence, Please Keep The Following Critical Points In Mind

No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.
Please always verify communications:
Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.
What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

new_jobs.description:
The research assistant will work under the supervision of Dr. Soto-Shoender on a research project he is currently conducting.,

The research project involves managing and preparing field data for analyses. The RA will work with data collected via camera traps and passive acoustic monitoring devices in the Central Volcanic Chain of Guatemala. The project’s objective is to identify habitat associations and threats to native mammals and birds in the mountain ecosystems of Guatemala and study how they respond to invasive predators (free-roaming dogs). The RA duties on this project will be the following:
Arrange the camera trapping dataset in excel according to specified criteria
Conduct basic data exploration and analyses on the data
Assist in the preparation of manuscripts to submit to peer-reviewed journals

The research assistant will be trained in basic principles of data management and analysis, but they will be asked to independently learn about the specific techniques we will use.
Other duties as assigned
